issues: 文档只有灰色骨架条，看不出被扫描的是一份什么东西，不像真实文档（Q10）
扫描光带是 10px 粗黑线加 50% 黑灰渐变拖尾，压在白纸上读成一块脏污的阴影而不是光
拖尾定长 82px，每趟换向时整块从光带一侧瞬间跳到另一侧
取景括号是 8px 粗的方头黑边，直线收位没有落定感
背景是纯色 #F1F1F3 平铺，文档阴影单薄，整体发平
changes: 骨架换成出版级合同明细表：文档图标 + 标题 + 元信息 + PDF 页数 chip、4 列 7 行明细与合计行，DesignStage 改 raster="zoom" 让小字按成片尺寸栅格化
光带改成靛蓝扫描光：1.2px 中心提亮的光芯 + 10px 对称柔辉 + 正片叠底的色调拖尾（SCAN .2→0），光芯经过的表格行被轻微照亮
拖尾长度按扫描速度伸缩（最长 82px，趟末停顿处收成 0），换向时尾迹自然收回再在另一侧长出
括号改成 1.6px 圆头 SVG 描边，从外侧沿对角收进来并带约 8% 过冲落定，保留 0.022 错峰
背景换柔光渐变底 + 暗角 + 颗粒；文档加发丝线、顶部内高光与随落位收紧的两层阴影（scale 0.86→1 改 snappy 缓动）
issuesEn: The document was only grey skeleton bars, so it never read as a real document being scanned (Q10)
The scan beam was a 10px black line with a 50% grey gradient tail, reading as a dirty shadow on white paper rather than light
The 82px tail had a fixed length and jumped from one side of the beam to the other on every turnaround
The viewfinder brackets were thick square-capped black borders that slid in linearly with no settle
The background was a flat #F1F1F3 fill and the document shadow was thin, so the frame felt flat
changesEn: Replaced the skeleton with a publication-grade vendor agreement table: file icon, title, metadata and page chip, 4 columns by 7 rows plus a total line; DesignStage now uses raster="zoom" so small text rasterises at output size
The beam is now an indigo scan light: a 1.2px core brightened in the middle, a 10px symmetric glow and a multiply-blended tinted tail (SCAN .2→0); table rows light up faintly as the core passes
Tail length follows scan speed (max 82px, zero during the end-of-pass pause), so on turnaround it retracts and regrows on the other side
Brackets are 1.6px round-capped SVG strokes closing in diagonally from outside with an ~8% overshoot, keeping the 0.022 stagger
Soft gradient backdrop with vignette and grain; the document gets a hairline, top inner highlight and a two-layer shadow that tightens as it lands (scale 0.86→1 now on a snappy ease)
